steps: Calculate the initial volume of the cube: V = (10 cm)^3 = 10^{-3} m^3.
Use the bulk modulus formula: B = \Delta P / (\Delta V / V), which gives \Delta V = (\Delta P \cdot V) / B.
Substitute the given values: \Delta V = (7 \times 10^6 \times 10^{-3}) / (1.4 \times 10^{11}) m^3.
Calculate the volume contraction in m^3: \Delta V = 5 \times 10^{-8} m^3.
Convert the volume contraction to mm^3: \Delta V = 5 \times 10^{-8} \times 10^9 mm^3 = 50 mm^3.
